economy.summary: Her campaign site says she is committed to lowering everyday expenses, supporting fair wages, and making sure hard work actually pays off; it also supports expanding affordable housing options.
economy.short: Supports lowering everyday expenses, fair wages, affordable housing options.

taxes.summary: In a VOTE411 voter guide response on the state budget process, she said the state needs to continue to advocate for a timely and balanced budget.
taxes.short: Advocates a timely and balanced state budget.

abortion.summary: Her campaign site lists an endorsement from Planned Parenthood, which backs candidates who support abortion rights; the site does not detail an abortion position.
abortion.short: Endorsed by Planned Parenthood; site does not detail position.

education.summary: Her campaign site says she supports investing in public schools, backing teachers, and making sure every student has access to a high-quality education regardless of zip code.
education.short: Supports investing in public schools, backing teachers, student access.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign site says she is focused on lowering healthcare costs, expanding access, and making sure patients come first, saying no one should have to choose between paying bills and getting care.
healthcare.short: Supports lowering healthcare costs, expanding access, putting patients first.

energy.summary: Her campaign site says everyone deserves clean air, safe water, and healthy communities, and that she supports practical, forward-looking solutions that protect the environment while creating jobs.
energy.short: Supports environmental protections paired with creating jobs.

guns.summary: Her campaign site lists an endorsement from Moms Demand Action, a group that backs candidates who support gun safety measures; the site does not detail a gun policy position.
guns.short: Endorsed by Moms Demand Action; site does not detail position.

economy.summary: His campaign platform calls for reducing energy, gasoline, and grocery prices and for cutting red tape and regulations he says drive up costs for families.
economy.short: Proposes cutting regulations to lower energy, gas, grocery prices.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform commits to reining in state spending, which he says has grown almost 65 percent under two Democratic governors, and to eliminating property taxes so seniors on fixed incomes can remain in their homes.
taxes.short: Proposes reining in state spending and eliminating property taxes.

healthcare.summary: In a VOTE411 voter guide response naming the rising cost of living as the district's most pressing issue, he said he would focus on easing tax burdens, stabilizing costs, and improving access to healthcare.
healthcare.short: Says he would focus on improving access to healthcare.

energy.summary: His campaign platform supports responsible development of Pennsylvania's natural gas, coal, and nuclear resources, saying the state should become a world leader in energy development and create good-paying jobs.
energy.short: Supports developing natural gas, coal, nuclear resources; energy jobs.

guns.summary: His campaign platform pledges support for police, firefighters, and EMTs, opposes defunding law enforcement, and commits to protecting Second Amendment rights; his site notes an endorsement from Gun Owners of America.
guns.short: Supports first responders; commits to protecting Second Amendment rights.
